notablePrerequisites:
You control fewer than nine lands.
You have a nonartifact land card in hand.
description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting a nonartifact land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning any other nonartifact land from the battlefield to your hand.
If the land entered untapped and can produce mana, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life
